text: Gus sent you? Then you're the one off the west sand! Everyone's talking about you. Well. Pell's talking. Same thing.
Nothing of yours washed up, sorry, love. But here's how Brinehollow works: you find it, I buy it. Treasure, plunder, anything that glitters.
Gold buys the rest. Sela sells clothes, Ida sells jars and hardtack, Marlo sells fish, Gus sells rum. And I buy everything. Talk to any of us to trade.

Now, if you're going to go finding things, you'd better learn which end of a sword goes in the pirate. Sergeant Vey trains anyone with a pulse, in the yard past the tavern. Tell him Nessa sent you. He'll pretend to be annoyed.
Ooh, a new face! Welcome, welcome!
Nessa's Notions: rope, salt, citrus, and things I promise are not stolen.

menu.text: What can Nessa do for you?

trade.text: Let's see what you've dragged up from the deep!

text: Rope, salt, rum, and pretty things for pretty captains. Earrings! Eyepatches! Both, if you're bold.
And I buy. Treasure, plunder, anything that glitters. Full price for sea-gems, which is more than the Marines will give you.
Gold's gold. Treasure's better: a good twenty-odd gold a gem, from me, more for the rare ones. Sell it, then spend it at Tackett's yard. A better ship finds better treasure.
Last I heard you'd stowed {banked} pieces aboard. Keep it up!
Gold's gold. Treasure's better: a good twenty-odd gold a gem, from me, more for the rare ones.
Pirates carry plenty of both, and they're not using it properly. Bring me whatever you take off them.
Wren swears there's a stash hidden in the jungle west of the ruins. Wren also swears the moon owes her money.
There's supposed to be something shiny up by the lighthouse, too. Ambrose won't say what.

bye.text: Come back rich! Or at least come back.
